changeSet.author: osmontero
changeSet.comment: Reverse of 20261030003_utm_viz_keyword. utm.* is pinned to bare keyword in the installer template (search.go) on this line, so visualization bucket fields read the bare utm.X path again — the one form valid on fresh (pinned) indices AND on indices that converge via reindex/roll-off. Idempotent: after the rewrite the quoted utm.X.keyword token no longer exists, so a re-run matches nothing. utm.responseElements.credentials.expiration was never touched by 20261030003 (date type, no .keyword sub-field) and needs no reverse step.
